entities.name: Maredudd ap Bleddyn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maredudd ap Bleddyn was the founder of the resurrected Kingdom of Powys in eastern Wales. He was involved in the rebellions against Henry I of England. He was featured in the Brut y Tywysogion, and was succeeded by his son, Prince Madog ap Maredudd.
